description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for managing favorites in the application, specifically handling the removal of an article from a user's favorites. It includes a request command, a validator, and a handler that interacts with the database context to remove a favorite and return the updated article data.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to remove an article from favorites, identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug provided in the command is neither null nor empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of removing a favorite for the current user, updating the database, and returning the updated article envelope.

methods.name: Delete.CommandValidator.CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets up validation rules for the command.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of fetching the article, verifying the user, removing favorite, updating data, and returning the article envelope.
